approved_scope.title: GitHub plugin repo gate reads the allowlist file plus env overlays so file deny lists apply and file-only allow lists work (GITHUB-6, ALLOW-4)
approved_scope.description: GitHub plugin repo gate reads the allowlist file plus env overlays so file deny lists apply and file-only allow lists work (GITHUB-6, ALLOW-4)
acceptance_criteria: With deny_repos/deny_orgs only in the allowlist file and the allow list only in env, every GitHub plugin (issue/PR create, comment, review, reads) and the /work PR step refuse the denied repo or org with exit 3 / repo-denied; with an allow list only in the file, allowed repos pass and unlisted repos are still refused
